Unsolicited Ratings
Karatum rates agents from the Census
without being asked
. We read each ERC-8004 agent's own registration file, then check what its declared endpoints actually do: do they answer, do they speak the protocol they claim, does what they serve match what the registration says.
This is not a Karatum certificate.
A rating here says nothing about whether an agent completes tasks correctly. That is measured on a Mirror fork and needs the owner:
verify your agent
. Ratings come from public, read-only requests identified as
